description: Create and modify ZIP archives with Info-ZIP Zip.

option.name: --adjust-sfx
tip: adjust offsets in a self-extracting archive

option.name: --archive-comment
tip: prompt for an archive comment

option.name: --before-date
tip: include only files modified before the given date

option.name: --compress-1
tip: compress level 1 (1 fastest, 9 best)

option.name: --compress-2
tip: compress level 2 (1 fastest, 9 best)

option.name: --compress-3
tip: compress level 3 (1 fastest, 9 best)

option.name: --compress-4
tip: compress level 4 (1 fastest, 9 best)

option.name: --compress-5
tip: compress level 5 (1 fastest, 9 best)

option.name: --compress-6
tip: compress level 6 (1 fastest, 9 best)

option.name: --compress-7
tip: compress level 7 (1 fastest, 9 best)

option.name: --compress-8
tip: compress level 8 (1 fastest, 9 best)

option.name: --compress-9
tip: compress level 9 (1 fastest, 9 best)

option.name: --compression-method
tip: set the compression method
Possible values: store, deflate, bzip2

next.name: bzip2
tip: use bzip2 compression

next.name: deflate
tip: use the original zip deflate method

next.name: store
tip: store without compression

option.name: --copy-entries
tip: copy entries from the archive instead of the file system

option.name: --delete
tip: delete entries from the archive

option.name: --difference-archive
tip: create an archive containing only changed or new files

option.name: --display-bytes
tip: display running byte counts
`-db-` disables it

option.name: --display-bytes-
tip: do not display running byte counts

option.name: --display-counts
tip: display running entry counts
`-dc-` disables it

option.name: --display-counts-
tip: do not display running entry counts

option.name: --display-dots
tip: display progress dots as each file is processed
`-dd-` disables it

option.name: --display-dots-
tip: do not display progress dots per file

option.name: --display-globaldots
tip: display progress dots for the whole archive instead of per file
`-dg-` disables it

option.name: --display-globaldots-
tip: do not display global progress dots

option.name: --display-usize
tip: display the uncompressed size of each entry
`-du-` disables it

option.name: --display-usize-
tip: do not display uncompressed sizes

option.name: --display-volume
tip: display the volume (disk) number
`-dv-` disables it

option.name: --display-volume-
tip: do not display volume numbers

option.name: --DOS-names
tip: force 8.3 DOS file names

option.name: --dot-size
tip: set the progress dot size (default 10m)

option.name: --encrypt
tip: encrypt entries and prompt for a password

option.name: --entry-comments
tip: prompt for a one-line comment for each entry

option.name: --exclude
tip: exclude files matching the patterns

option.name: --fifo
tip: read Unix FIFOs, waiting on an open pipe
`-FI-` disables it

option.name: --fifo-
tip: do not read Unix FIFOs

option.name: --filesync
tip: sync the archive with the file system: add, update and delete entries

option.name: --fix
tip: try to fix a mostly intact archive

option.name: --fixfix
tip: try harder to salvage a damaged archive

option.name: --force-descriptors
tip: force data descriptors as if streaming

option.name: --force-zip64
tip: force Zip64 format
`-fz-` disables it

option.name: --force-zip64-
tip: do not force Zip64 format

option.name: --freshen
tip: freshen existing entries only; add no new files

option.name: --from-crlf
tip: convert text file line ends from CRLF to LF

option.name: --from-date
tip: exclude files modified before the given date

option.name: --grow
tip: grow an existing archive instead of replacing it

option.name: --help
tip: show help

option.name: --include
tip: include only files matching the patterns

option.name: --junk-paths
tip: strip directory names and store only file names

option.name: --junk-sfx
tip: strip a prepended self-extractor from the archive

option.name: --latest-time
tip: set the archive time to the latest entry time

option.name: --license
tip: show the software license

option.name: --log-append
tip: append to an existing log file
`-la-` overwrites it instead

option.name: --log-append-
tip: overwrite the log instead of appending

option.name: --log-info
tip: include informational messages in the log
`-li-` logs only warnings and errors

option.name: --log-info-
tip: log only warnings and errors

option.name: --logfile-path
tip: write the log to the given file

option.name: --more-help
tip: show extended help

option.name: --move
tip: add files to the archive, then delete the originals

option.name: --must-match
tip: fail if an input pattern matches nothing or a file is unreadable

option.name: --names-stdin
tip: read file names from standard input, one per line

option.name: --no-dir-entries
tip: do not store directory entries themselves

option.name: --no-wild
tip: treat wildcards as literal characters

option.name: --output-file
tip: write the output archive to a different file

option.name: --password
tip: encrypt entries with the given password

option.name: --paths
tip: store path names

option.name: --quiet
tip: quiet operation

option.name: --recurse-paths
tip: recurse into directories

option.name: --recurse-patterns
tip: recurse the current directory and match patterns

option.name: --regex
tip: allow [list] matching with regular expressions

option.name: --show-command
tip: show the command line as processed and exit

option.name: --show-debug
tip: show debugging information

option.name: --show-files
tip: show the files to operate on and exit
`-sf-` writes the list to the log only

option.name: --show-files-
tip: write the file list to the log only, without printing it

option.name: --show-just-unicode
tip: like -sf, show only escaped UTF-8 names
`-sU-` disables it

option.name: --show-just-unicode-
tip: do not show only escaped UTF-8 names

option.name: --show-options
tip: show all available options on this system

option.name: --show-unicode
tip: like -sf, also show escaped UTF-8 names
`-su-` disables it

option.name: --show-unicode-
tip: do not show escaped UTF-8 names in addition to normal names

option.name: --split-bell
tip: ring the bell when pausing for the next split

option.name: --split-pause
tip: pause after each split so the destination can be changed

option.name: --split-size
tip: create a split archive with the given split size
`-s=0` or `-s-` disables splitting
disable splitting

next.name: 100k
tip: 100 kB splits

next.name: 10m
tip: 10 MB splits

next.name: 1m
tip: 1 MB splits

option.name: --split-verbose
tip: be verbose about split creation

option.name: --store
tip: store files without compression

option.name: --strip-extra
tip: strip extra fields; `-X-` keeps all of them

option.name: --strip-extra-
tip: keep all extra fields

option.name: --suffixes
tip: do not compress files with the given suffixes

option.name: --symlinks
tip: store symbolic links as links

option.name: --temp-path
tip: use the given directory for the temporary archive

option.name: --test
tip: test the updated archive with unzip before replacing it

option.name: --to-crlf
tip: convert text file line ends from LF to CRLF

option.name: --unicode
tip: set Unicode path handling
Possible values: Quit, Warn, Ignore, No, Escape, UTF8

next.name: Escape
tip: escape every character outside ASCII

next.name: Ignore
tip: silently ignore the UTF-8 path on a mismatch

next.name: No
tip: ignore all UTF-8 paths

next.name: Quit
tip: exit with an error on a Unicode path mismatch

next.name: UTF8
tip: store UTF-8 in entry path and comment fields

next.name: Warn
tip: warn and ignore the UTF-8 path on a mismatch (default)

option.name: --unzip-command
tip: use the given unzip command to test the updated archive

option.name: --update
tip: update existing entries and add new files

option.name: --verbose
tip: verbose operation; `zip -v` alone shows version information

option.name: --version
tip: show version information when used alone

option.name: --wild-stop-dirs
tip: make * stop at directory separators; ** still crosses them

option.name: -AC
tip: (Windows only) after creating the archive, clear the DOS Archive bit of included files

option.name: -AS
tip: (Windows only) include only files with the DOS Archive bit set

option.name: -ic
tip: ignore case when matching archive entries
